summary: Contributors adding new database dialects or bug-fixing existing ones. The primary task is adding a new entry to DIALECTS (ibis) or _CATALOG_REGISTRY (iceberg). For settings-driven connections, the settings pipeline is a second touch point.

concepts.name: Adding a new Ibis dialect
recommended_docs: Step 2: Add DialectSpec entry to DIALECTS dict
Step 3: Write per-backend settings class in core/settings/{dialect}.py
Step 4: Add adapter in adapters/{dialect}.py if needed
evidence: Per-backend settings files are two-line shells

concepts.name: Adding capability hooks to a dialect
recommended_docs: Hook function signatures: UpsertHook, CreateIndexHook, DropIndexHook, RenameTableHook
Register the hook in the DialectSpec entry

concepts.name: Test structure
recommended_docs: Use _snapshot_for_tests/_reset_for_tests for registry isolation in tests
DuckDB in-memory for fast dialect tests
